Autumn reminder for an efficient phase
Please take a moment
Travelers: bring your pet papers early for smooth check-in.

Our team will review carrier fit, comfort needs, and any care notes before boarding. <<FACT F012>> Keep your pet calm and secure while you wait, and let staff know if your animal needs extra space or support.

Please also have feeding guidance ready and share any recent health updates so we can plan carefully. <<FACT F030>> If you are connecting through Thornwick, <<FACT F022>> so please speak with the desk soon and allow us to guide you.

For help with any companion animal travel step, please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
